chat_room_message_payload.name: chat_room_message_payload
chat_room_message_payload.value: "chat_room_messages"."ciphertext" IS NULL OR ("chat_room_messages"."text" = '' AND "chat_room_messages"."replyTo" IS NULL)

chat_rooms_secret_private.name: chat_rooms_secret_private
chat_rooms_secret_private.value: "chat_rooms"."kind" <> 'secret' OR ("chat_rooms"."visibility" = 'private' AND "chat_rooms"."username" IS NULL AND "chat_rooms"."description" = '' AND "chat_rooms"."avatar" = '')

chat_rooms_public_username.name: chat_rooms_public_username
chat_rooms_public_username.value: ("chat_rooms"."visibility" = 'public' AND "chat_rooms"."username" IS NOT NULL) OR ("chat_rooms"."visibility" = 'private' AND "chat_rooms"."username" IS NULL)

payment_provider_currency.name: payment_provider_currency
payment_provider_currency.value: ("payment_orders"."provider"='telegram' AND "payment_orders"."currency"='XTR' AND "payment_orders"."telegramId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("payment_orders"."provider"='crypto' AND "payment_orders"."currency"='RUB')
